name: whatsgram
description: WhatsGram — Encrypted Messaging, Feed & Explore, Reels, Story Highlights & Gemini AI

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');for(const p of ['package.json','vercel.json','manifest.webmanifest'])JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));for(const d of ['api','lib'])for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js')))cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+f]);for(const f of ['sw.js','assets/app.js']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f]);}for(const f of ['index.html','assets/app.css','.env.example','README.md']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);}console.log('PROJECT_CHECK_OK');"
